```sql
SELECT p.poi_name
FROM pois p
WHERE p.tourism = 'attraction'
  AND ST_Azimuth(p.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%House of Air%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' LIMIT 1)) BETWEEN RADIANS(67.5) AND RADIANS(112.5)
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%House of Air%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' LIMIT 1)
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql

  AND leisure = 'nature_reserve'
ORDER BY parks.geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Central Florida Zoo & Botanical Gardens%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Sanford%' LIMIT 1)
```
```sql
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT poi_name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Glenwood Caverns Adventure Park%' LIMIT 1)::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois
WHERE tourism = 'zoo'
  AND ST_Within((SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Glenwood Caverns Adventure Park%' LIMIT 1)::geography, ST_Buffer(p.geometry::geography, 100000))
  AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(p.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Glenwood Caverns Adventure Park%' LIMIT 1))) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Glenwood Caverns Adventure Park%' LIMIT 1)
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT poi_name, ST_Distance(p1.geometry::geography, p2.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois p1
JOIN pois p2 ON ST_DWithin(p1.geometry::geography, p2.geometry::geography, 10000)
WHERE p1.tourism = 'gallery'
  AND p2.poi_name ILIKE '%Tilt Studio%'
  AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(p2.geometry, p1.geometry)) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5
ORDER BY p1.geometry <-> p2.geometry
LIMIT 1;
```
